description: Report runtime versions: server name + version (from package.json), how it was installed, MCP protocol version, Node version, platform os/arch, and the active MOJULO_HOME. `workers: true` adds the optional workers this host has (Blender, Godot, Unity, Unreal, a slicer, OpenSCAD, ffmpeg, Chromium): each one's path or null, the env var that points at it, and what still happens without it. Local only, no network call. Read-only, idempotent.
name: version
title: Server version
